complexity.notes: Accumulating with `valid *= isValidLine(...)` is cute but obscure; `and` or `all()` would be clearer. `line.count(num)` inside a loop is O(n^2) per line — irrelevant at length 9. The `List` annotation needs `from typing import List`; under CPython 3.14 (PEP 649) annotations are never evaluated, so the missing import is harmless at runtime but still worth adding.
complexity.summary: Checks each of the 9 rows, 9 columns, and 9 boxes for duplicate non-empty cells using a helper that calls line.count(num) for every cell; all lines have fixed length 9, so everything is constant work.
